user.title: Connect BENY wallbox
user.description: Recommended gateway settings: TCP Server, Modbus TCP to RTU, TCP port 502; RS485: 4800 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (8N1). Set these on the gateway itself; this integration does not change them. Disable Plug & Play on the charger for START/STOP control. Setup checks the connection by reading only.

data_description.name: A name for this charger in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Enter the IP address or hostname shown by your gateway or router. DHCP with an address reservation is recommended. Do not include http:// or a port.
data_description.port: Recommended: 502 for Modbus TCP. Enter the gateway's actual TCP server port; port 80 is normally its web interface.
data_description.unit_id: BENY default: 1. Use the charger address if it was changed. This is the RS485 device address, not the gateway IP.
data_description.transport: Choose Modbus TCP for a gateway set to Modbus TCP to RTU. Choose Modbus RTU over TCP only for transparent forwarding of RTU frames with CRC.

limits.title: Current ceiling and controls
limits.description: The default current ceiling is 6 A. Increase only to the verified installation limit, at most 32 A. This ceiling limits commands from this integration; it does not change the permanent charger limit or app control. Setup does not start charging.

data_description.max_current: Default: 6 A. Set a verified limit for the installation, at most 32 A. This restricts commands from this integration; it does not provide dynamic load balancing.
data_description.control_enabled: Enable the charging switch and current setting. Disable for monitoring only. Enabling this option does not start charging.
